description:
Release-blocking finding from review: Linear OAuth tests fail with the same `missing plug dependency` failure path as Jira, in `Req.Steps.run_plug/1`. The failing tests are in `apps/jido_connect_linear/test/jido_connect/linear/oauth_test.exs` and cover token exchange, refresh, malformed success responses, provider error responses, and upstream HTTP error normalization.

Why this matters: Linear and Jira are our issue/work-management connectors and likely to be used by `jido_chat` style handoff workflows. OAuth token handling must be locally testable before live checks. This is also a signal that Pi-generated packages can have correct-looking Mix deps but still fail under the package's actual test command.

Acceptance:
- Diagnose why Plug is not available to `Req.Test` in the Linear package despite the test-only dependency.
- Fix the package/test setup so `cd apps/jido_connect_linear && mix test test/jido_connect/linear/oauth_test.exs` passes.
- `cd apps/jido_connect_linear && mix test --no-deps-check` passes.
- Keep tests offline; do not call Linear live APIs.
- Preserve or improve malformed response and error normalization assertions.
- If sharing a helper with Jira, keep it narrowly scoped and make both package test commands pass independently.
title: [REVIEW-S04] Fix Linear OAuth Req.Test runtime setup
